In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the loss of myo‐epithelial cells is an early and important event in breast carcinogenesis, and the loss of basement membranes is a late event.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
myoepithelia and basement membranes are important components in the architecture of benign and malignant human breasts, and that their loss may be used for differential diagnosis of breast lesions.
